rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or organization you are competing against.

example.english: Our team finally beat that formidable competitor this year.
example.traditional: 我哋隊今年終於擊敗咗嗰個勁對手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 gik1 baai6 zo2 go2 go3 ging6 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this for anyone who takes part in a competition, without emphasizing that they are your opponent.

example.english: Each competitor in this track-and-field competition has to check in first.
example.traditional: 今次田徑比賽嘅參賽者都要先報到。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 tin4 ging3 bei2 coi3 ge3 caam1 coi3 ze2 dou1 jiu3 sin1 bou3 dou3

rows.note: Use this mainly for an athlete or other participant representing a team or competing in a sporting event.

example.english: The competitor representing Hong Kong had already started warming up in the morning.
example.traditional: 代表香港出賽嗰位選手朝早已經開始熱身。
example.jyutping: doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 coi3 go2 wai2 syun2 sau2 ziu1 zou2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 jit6 san1
